---
title: "Tidycensus Presentation"
---

This presentation introduces `tidycensus` as a practical interface to Census and American Community Survey data. The point was to show why the package is a useful bridge between the Census API and ordinary R workflows: less manual downloading, cleaner data frames, and easier joins with geography.
